title: MedRedFlag: Investigating how LLMs Redirect Misconceptions in Real-World Health Communication

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to real-world patient questions containing false medical assumptions using an LLM-as-a-judge to measure the rate at which models accommodate (implicitly validate or agree with) rather than appropriately redirect these incorrect premises.
Qualitative physician review of model outputs to observe if LLMs anchor onto specific diagnoses assumed by the user without sufficiently interrogating the broader symptom context.
